profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DDOG, headquartered in New York, NY, with SEC CIK 0001561550. Its website presents it as a cloud monitoring service, offering a way to see metrics from apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial.

The site also markets security alongside observability, describing an approach to defending against AI-powered attacks. In the company's framing, integrating security and observability lets organizations decode runtime execution, reduce exposure in dynamic AI environments, and run detection and response at what it calls agentic speed.

The facts held on the company list no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its litigation exposure is recorded against New York, with a count of 448.
